verdict.localBenefitRecommendation: Accept the observed local inner-edge benefit and retain this frozen candidate; complete the outstanding technical gates before final delivery.
verdict.summary: The actual matched frames support a useful local inner-edge repair. The segmented upper strip in speech is removed while the mouth opening and outer lip body remain. The thin central slit in pucker is substantially closed while the external pucker form remains. This is consistent with the intended ownership correction, without evidence of buying the improvement by shrinking the whole action.

evidenceScope.person: The fixed R04 reference person only
evidenceScope.comparisonMeaning: R04-labelled frames in this candidate directory are the correction-disabled native R04 path inside the append-only R05 build. Immutable ancestor bytes were verified. A separately loaded R04 equality check stopped at a material-list assertion before completing; it is not counted as passed here.
evidenceScope.technicalRunStatus: 13 checks passed and 1 failed before later acceptance stages. There are 22 valid paired image frames. Remaining independent-baseline, restore and other later gates must be completed by the verifier owner.
evidenceScope.hashDomains: originalPNGFiles.sha256 hashes the original encoded PNG file bytes and matches qa.frames[].pngSHA256. framebufferRGBAsha256 hashes the original bottom-up RGBA framebuffer bytes and matches qa.frames[].sha256 and the comparison on/off hashes. These are distinct byte domains.

speak.before: At larger action progress the upper inner edge has a narrow segmented pink strip hanging across the opening. The lower inner edge also has an obvious pale block-like band.
speak.after: The hanging upper strip is absent in the reviewed R05 frames. The lower pale segmented band is reduced. The mouth remains open, with the same external width, outer lip contours and large-scale form.
speak.progress: 25 percent shows only a small visible difference. At 50, 75 and 100 percent the removal of the inner strip is increasingly clear. No sudden new fold or discontinuity is apparent across these sampled stages.
speak.limitation: Four sampled progress values do not establish frame-by-frame temporal smoothness. More exposed tooth area near the corrected inner edge is an expected visibility change, not by itself proof of tooth motion.

pucker.before: At 50 percent and above, a thin pink/grey tooth slit opens across the centre despite the sealed pucker form.
pucker.after: The central slit is substantially closed. The external upper/lower lip bulges, pucker outline and existing sharp corner folds remain visibly in the same places.
pucker.progress: The correction is subtle at 25 percent and clearly suppresses the emerging central slit at 50, 75 and 100 percent. It does not produce the enlarged gap seen in the no-closure diagnostic counterfactual.
pucker.limitation: The remaining narrow dark closure line and sharp corner creases are not a complete natural-lip result. No claim is made that the existing pucker anatomy is otherwise correct.

visualFindings.newDeformation: No additional outer lip distortion or larger corner fold was found in the 16 reviewed active frames. This is limited to the displayed views, person and actions.

causalCrossCheck.matchedInputs: Across all 11 QA comparisons, the reviewer independently compared stored on/off values and found the declared pose, materials, camera, lighting and canonical position hash equal. The QA also records equal actual shader fingerprints.

speakFull.interpretation: The visible speech change accompanies only the local ownership correction in this pose; closure is not the mechanism here.

puckerFull.interpretation: The visible pucker change accompanies the closure ownership correction. The pucker local terms are not reduced by this module in this pose.

reference.meaning: The candidate reassigns selected samples in both directions. It is not a global reduction of upper/lower motion or a global lifting of the inner edge.

causalCrossCheck.neutralAndJaw: The neutral and both jaw-view pairs have exactly equal image hashes and zero changed pixels. Solver-reported closure corrections in these controls are approximately 4e-8 mm and below the stored display/image response.
causalCrossCheck.lifecycle: All reviewed enabled reports are valid, have no errors, and report one local and one closure boundary with restored hooks. These are solver telemetry corroborating the code path, not independent proof of visual quality.
causalCrossCheck.retentionQualification: The QA speaking-versus-jaw check establishes a nonzero retained speaking action, not an exact whole-surface amplitude ratio. The actual outer-body pixel comparisons below and visual review provide additional bounded evidence against wholesale action shrinkage.

independentPixelChecks.method: Read original PNG RGB channels and compare max absolute channel difference. No image was edited or generated. Rectangles were selected after visual inspection to sample visible external lip bodies; they are not anatomical masks or whole-surface measurements.
independentPixelChecks.roiSelection: The four ROI coordinates were chosen once from the displayed full-action images, before the pixel-difference calculation. They sample central external lip bodies away from the opening and corner folds. They were not optimized against the measured differences. Consequently they support a bounded preservation check, not an exhaustive outer-lip or movement-amplitude measurement.
independentPixelChecks.coordinateConvention: Original 640x512 PNG coordinates; origin at top-left, x rightward, y downward. ROI arrays are [x0,y0,x1,y1] with x1/y1 excluded. Whole-difference bounds include both endpoints and use any nonzero RGB channel difference.
independentPixelChecks.interpretation: The correction changes the inner-edge image region while leaving the sampled outer lip body essentially or exactly unchanged. These measurements locate the response; the judgment that the strip looks better comes from the actual image review.

remainingVisibleIssues: Sharp, pinched corner folds persist, particularly in pucker.
The lip surface remains broad and rather uniform with visibly procedural vertical detail.
Tooth and oral cavity shapes/materials are still simplified.
A narrow dark closure edge remains; this review does not certify contact anatomy or absence of hidden self-intersection.
nextDecision: Keep the frozen first candidate. Complete the interrupted independent-baseline and archive gates. Do not add new geometry tuning merely to chase remaining unrelated material or mouth-corner defects within this candidate.
